messages.subject: Research question
parts:
Hey everyone,

Sorry for putting so many questions the last few weeks, but I'm new to this and I just had a question regarding the use of the output I get. I have run the program and I think my results are reliable but there are a few rarer species that I sighted that I could not run in the distance program due to the amount of sightings I had of the species, between 2-4 sightings for the entire species. Would it be reasonable to include these species in statistical analysis in which I group abundance data, such as if I wanted to do total bird densities at varying distances from houses, or would this be a red flag in the eyes of publishers? I planned already to run statistical analyses on each species separate and exclude rarer species due to limited sightings but would it be right to include rare species with the new abundance data I got from running the distance program when looking into overall trends of birds within the ecosystem?

thanks
Eric
